# GraphControls

The overlay controls on the graph canvas: zoom in and out, fit, reset, pause or resume the layout, link layers, 2D/3D, a minimap and the node and link count.

`SongNodes.GraphControls` · Graph

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.GraphControls nodeCount={0} edgeCount={0} zoom={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.GraphControls" node-count="{{0}}" edge-count="{{0}}" zoom="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (GraphControlsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nodeCount` * | `number` | Node and link counts after filters. |
| `edgeCount` * | `number` |  |
| `zoom` * | `number` | Zoom factor, 0.25–4. |
| `onZoomIn` * | `() => void` |  |
| `onZoomOut` * | `() => void` |  |
| `onFit` * | `() => void` | Fit the whole graph in view. |
| `onReset` * | `() => void` | Back to 100% centred. |
| `running` * | `boolean` | Layout simulation running. |
| `onToggleRunning` * | `() => void` |  |
| `layers` * | `Record<GraphEdgeType, boolean>` | Link layers on/off. |
| `onLayersChange` * | `(layers: Record<GraphEdgeType, boolean>) => void` |  |
| `dimension` | `"2d" \| "3d"` | 2D/3D, omit to hide the switch. |
| `onDimensionChange` | `(d: "2d" \| "3d") => void` |  |
| `viewport` | `{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }` | Minimap viewport in graph units; omit to hide the minimap. |
